review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 双方当前信仰/增减伤层与末取整/保留仍收益/未消费附伤刷新均对应原答案和真实状态对照。
review.singleBehavior: 初始面板双攻判正邪并自身信仰；当前两方信仰对象HP总比决定每15%减10%及每损失10%增15%。魂印层实际正差合计末统一取整为意念，不受后续盾/免疫/限伤及剩HP裁剪；穿减按实际生效比。回初正气平分魂印回复、邪气下一攻击等额固伤；不减期保留仍收益，后续正数附伤刷新、MISS/无效已用攻击消费，属性/药剂不消费。
review.deferredBehavior: 真实己方队伍的信仰对象登场修改；实际场下信仰者HP纳入总比及平分回复；真正下场保留意念和再次登场衔接。当前双方能以自身为信仰对象的分支已实现并核验。
review.trigger: 正气登场将己方精灵信仰对象改为自身；以自身为信仰对象的精灵总合计体力；法之意念下场保留

dependencyEvidence.quote: 将己方精灵的信仰对象改为自身

success.name: 4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方
success.assertion: test('4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方',()=>{for(const [atk,spa,form]of[[200,100,'positive'],[100,200,'evil'],[100,100,null]]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk,spa}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.form,form);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].statusState?.faithSourceSide,form?0:undefined);s.fighters[0].ailments['狂信']=5;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29425)],4);}});

success.name: 4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗
success.assertion: test('4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','skillBan','cut','full']){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='cut')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?9000:mode==='cut'?1150:1300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

success.name: 4933邪气消耗意念为下一次攻击固定附伤，属性与药剂不消费，免固仍消费一次
success.assertion: test('4933邪气消耗意念为下一次攻击固定附伤，属性与药剂不消费，免固仍消费一次',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,300);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,300);s.moveDefinitions[key(38494)].operations=[];if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,38494,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thoughtGains.at(-1).amount);}});

success.name: 4933单个信仰HP分档真实增减伤，魂印层正差在回末实际计意念且免疫不抹去
success.assertion: test('4933单个信仰HP分档真实增减伤，魂印层正差在回末实际计意念且免疫不抹去',()=>{const reduced=[];for(const hp of[9000,4499]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});turn(s,29425,10127);reduced.push(sum(s,'attack',1));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,hp-reduced.at(-1));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought>0);}assert.ok(reduced[0]<reduced[1]);const damages=[];for(const hp of[9000,4499]){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});turn(s,38494,20309);damages.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,hp===9000?0:s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thoughtGains.at(-1).amount);}assert.ok(damages[1]>damages[0]);});

success.name: 4933双方信仰合计分母为两者最大HP，意念不减仍产附伤且保留，未消费旧附伤刷新本轮值
success.assertion: test('4933双方信仰合计分母为两者最大HP，意念不减仍产附伤且保留，未消费旧附伤刷新本轮值',()=>{for(const mode of['two','freeze','extra']){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}}),st=s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128;if(mode==='two')s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};else st.thought=100;if(mode==='freeze')timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减');if(mode==='extra')st.extra=200;turn(s,38494,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38494)],4);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='two'?0:100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,mode==='freeze'?100:0);}});

success.name: 4933已答信仰比例为双方HP合计除最大HP合计，正邪与总损失比例分档，实际狂信可令当前敌方信仰自身
success.assertion: test('4933已答信仰比例为双方HP合计除最大HP合计，正邪与总损失比例分档，实际狂信可令当前敌方信仰自身',()=>{for(const kind of ['incoming','outgoing']){const s=make({move:kind==='incoming'?29425:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,targetHp:3000,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},bStats:{maxHp:3000}});s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};let ratio,modifier;observe((e,c)=>{if(c.a.side!==0)return;if(e===(kind==='incoming'?'beforeIncomingAttack':'beforeDamage')){ratio=E.SOULS.registry[2128].abilities.ratio(c);modifier=kind==='incoming'?c.reduction:c.shuraOutgoing2128?.bonus;}},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,kind==='incoming'?10127:20117));assert.equal(ratio,.625);assert.ok(Math.abs(modifier-(kind==='incoming'?.4:.45))<1e-12);assert.ok(state(s).thought>0);}const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'狂信',c.a,false,false,2),true);},()=>turn(s,29425,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].statusState.faithSourceSide,0);});

success.name: 4933已答魂印减伤层差额计意念，后续免疫、护盾和伤害上限不抹去，穿减先削减实际生效比例
success.assertion: test('4933已答魂印减伤层差额计意念，后续免疫、护盾和伤害上限不抹去，穿减先削减实际生效比例',()=>{const gains=[];for(const mode of ['normal','immune','shield','cap','pierce']){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},bStats:{atk:3000}});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(s.fighters[0],9000,'4933-layer');if(mode==='cap')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害上限',{amount:1});if(mode==='pierce')markFire(s,1);turn(s,29425,10127);const events=state(s).damageChanges.filter(x=>x.round===1);assert.equal(events.length,1);assert.equal(events[0].kind,'reduction');assert.ok(Math.abs(events[0].coefficient-(mode==='pierce'?.3:.6))<1e-12);assert.equal(state(s).thought,Math.floor(events[0].unit*(mode==='pierce'?.3:.6)+1e-9));assert.ok(state(s).thought>0);gains.push(state(s).thought);if(mode==='immune'||mode==='shield')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);if(mode==='cap')assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),1);}assert.equal(gains[0],gains[1]);assert.equal(gains[0],gains[2]);assert.equal(gains[0],gains[3]);assert.ok(Math.abs(gains[0]-gains[4]*2)<=1);});

success.name: 4933已答魂印增伤层差额计意念，后续免攻与整盾不改所得；MISS、整招无效、属性招不凭空产生
success.assertion: test('4933已答魂印增伤层差额计意念，后续免攻与整盾不改所得；MISS、整招无效、属性招不凭空产生',()=>{const gains=[];for(const mode of ['normal','immune','shield','miss','invalid','status']){const s=make({move:mode==='status'?29425:mode==='miss'?38492:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss',hp:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(s.fighters[1],9000,'4933-out');if(mode==='miss')timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'attackBlock');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);const amount=state(s).thought;gains.push(amount);if(['miss','invalid','status'].includes(mode)){assert.equal(amount,0);assert.equal(state(s).damageChanges?.length??0,0);}else{const e=state(s).damageChanges[0];assert.equal(e.kind,'increase');assert.equal(e.coefficient,.75);assert.equal(amount,Math.floor(e.unit*.75+1e-9));assert.ok(amount>0);if(mode!=='normal')assert.equal(sum(s),0);}}assert.equal(gains[0],gains[1]);assert.equal(gains[0],gains[2]);});

success.name: 4933已答多段与双方同回合增减差额合计后一次取整，非红伤不计，下回合从本回零重新累计
success.assertion: test('4933已答多段与双方同回合增减差额合计后一次取整，非红伤不计，下回合从本回零重新累计',()=>{const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});turn(s,38494,10713);const st=state(s),events=st.damageChanges.filter(x=>x.round===1),expected=Math.floor(events.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.amount,0)+1e-9);assert.ok(events.some(e=>e.kind==='increase'));assert.ok(events.filter(e=>e.kind==='reduction').length>=2);assert.equal(st.thought,expected);assert.equal(gain(s).amount,expected);s.moveDefinitions[key(29425)].operations=[];turn(s,29425,10716);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(gain(s).amount,Math.floor(state(s).damageChanges.filter(e=>e.round===2).reduce((n,e)=>n+e.amount,0)+1e-9));assert.equal(state(s).thought,gain(s).amount);});

success.name: 4933已答正气意念保留期间仍每轮平均魂印回复当前两信仰者，禁技能疗不阻而回复倍率独立，结束后正常消耗
success.assertion: test('4933已答正气意念保留期间仍每轮平均魂印回复当前两信仰者，禁技能疗不阻而回复倍率独立，结束后正常消耗',()=>{const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1000,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};state(s).thought=600;timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减',{},1,2);timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+r*150);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1000+r*300);assert.equal(state(s).thought,r<3?600:0);assert.equal(gain(s).amount,0);}});

success.name: 4933已答邪气意念保留仍刷新下次附伤为本轮量，旧附伤不相加，属性和药剂保留，攻击含免固只消费一次
success.assertion: test('4933已答邪气意念保留仍刷新下次附伤为本轮量，旧附伤不相加，属性和药剂保留，攻击含免固只消费一次',()=>{for(const immune of [false,true]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});state(s).thought=100;state(s).extra=250;timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减',{},1,2);turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(state(s).thought,100);assert.equal(state(s).extra,100);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(state(s).thought,100);assert.equal(state(s).extra,100);if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');s.moveDefinitions[key(38494)].operations=[];turn(s,38494,20117);assert.equal(state(s).extra,0);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:100);assert.equal(state(s).thought,gain(s).amount);}});

success.name: 4933已答无魂印真实红伤对照校准增减计算基数，残血过量不裁剪层差，多段保留小数到回末统一取整
success.assertion: test('4933已答无魂印真实红伤对照校准增减计算基数，残血过量不裁剪层差，多段保留小数到回末统一取整',()=>{for(const incoming of [false,true]){const o={move:incoming?29425:38494,index:-1,hp:incoming?9000:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},bStats:{atk:incoming?3000:180}},a=make({...o,soul:true}),b=make(o);turn(a,o.move,incoming?10127:20117);turn(b,o.move,incoming?10127:20117);const e=state(a).damageChanges[0],coef=incoming?.6:.75;assert.equal(Math.floor(e.unit),sum(b,'attack',incoming?1:0));assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',incoming?1:0),Math.floor(e.unit*(incoming?.4:1.75)));assert.equal(state(a).thought,Math.floor(e.unit*coef+1e-9));if(!incoming){const z=make({...o,soul:true,targetHp:1});turn(z,o.move,20117);assert.equal(z.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(state(z).thought,state(a).thought);assert.equal(sum(z),sum(a));}}let witnessed=false;for(let seed=1;seed<=12;seed++){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0,enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});turn(s,38494,10713);const rows=state(s).damageChanges,raw=rows.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.amount,0),separate=rows.reduce((n,e)=>n+Math.floor(e.amount),0);assert.equal(state(s).thought,Math.floor(raw+1e-9));if(state(s).thought>separate)witnessed=true;}assert.equal(witnessed,true);});

failure.assertion: test('4933已答信仰比例为双方HP合计除最大HP合计，正邪与总损失比例分档，实际狂信可令当前敌方信仰自身',()=>{for(const kind of ['incoming','outgoing']){const s=make({move:kind==='incoming'?29425:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,targetHp:3000,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},bStats:{maxHp:3000}});s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};let ratio,modifier;observe((e,c)=>{if(c.a.side!==0)return;if(e===(kind==='incoming'?'beforeIncomingAttack':'beforeDamage')){ratio=E.SOULS.registry[2128].abilities.ratio(c);modifier=kind==='incoming'?c.reduction:c.shuraOutgoing2128?.bonus;}},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,kind==='incoming'?10127:20117));assert.equal(ratio,.625);assert.ok(Math.abs(modifier-(kind==='incoming'?.4:.45))<1e-12);assert.ok(state(s).thought>0);}const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'狂信',c.a,false,false,2),true);},()=>turn(s,29425,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].statusState.faithSourceSide,0);});

failure.name: 4933已答魂印减伤层差额计意念，后续免疫、护盾和伤害上限不抹去，穿减先削减实际生效比例
failure.assertion: test('4933已答魂印减伤层差额计意念，后续免疫、护盾和伤害上限不抹去，穿减先削减实际生效比例',()=>{const gains=[];for(const mode of ['normal','immune','shield','cap','pierce']){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},bStats:{atk:3000}});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(s.fighters[0],9000,'4933-layer');if(mode==='cap')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害上限',{amount:1});if(mode==='pierce')markFire(s,1);turn(s,29425,10127);const events=state(s).damageChanges.filter(x=>x.round===1);assert.equal(events.length,1);assert.equal(events[0].kind,'reduction');assert.ok(Math.abs(events[0].coefficient-(mode==='pierce'?.3:.6))<1e-12);assert.equal(state(s).thought,Math.floor(events[0].unit*(mode==='pierce'?.3:.6)+1e-9));assert.ok(state(s).thought>0);gains.push(state(s).thought);if(mode==='immune'||mode==='shield')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);if(mode==='cap')assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),1);}assert.equal(gains[0],gains[1]);assert.equal(gains[0],gains[2]);assert.equal(gains[0],gains[3]);assert.ok(Math.abs(gains[0]-gains[4]*2)<=1);});

failure.name: 4933已答魂印增伤层差额计意念，后续免攻与整盾不改所得；MISS、整招无效、属性招不凭空产生
failure.assertion: test('4933已答魂印增伤层差额计意念，后续免攻与整盾不改所得；MISS、整招无效、属性招不凭空产生',()=>{const gains=[];for(const mode of ['normal','immune','shield','miss','invalid','status']){const s=make({move:mode==='status'?29425:mode==='miss'?38492:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss',hp:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(s.fighters[1],9000,'4933-out');if(mode==='miss')timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'attackBlock');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);const amount=state(s).thought;gains.push(amount);if(['miss','invalid','status'].includes(mode)){assert.equal(amount,0);assert.equal(state(s).damageChanges?.length??0,0);}else{const e=state(s).damageChanges[0];assert.equal(e.kind,'increase');assert.equal(e.coefficient,.75);assert.equal(amount,Math.floor(e.unit*.75+1e-9));assert.ok(amount>0);if(mode!=='normal')assert.equal(sum(s),0);}}assert.equal(gains[0],gains[1]);assert.equal(gains[0],gains[2]);});

failure.name: 4933已答多段与双方同回合增减差额合计后一次取整，非红伤不计，下回合从本回零重新累计
failure.assertion: test('4933已答多段与双方同回合增减差额合计后一次取整，非红伤不计，下回合从本回零重新累计',()=>{const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});turn(s,38494,10713);const st=state(s),events=st.damageChanges.filter(x=>x.round===1),expected=Math.floor(events.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.amount,0)+1e-9);assert.ok(events.some(e=>e.kind==='increase'));assert.ok(events.filter(e=>e.kind==='reduction').length>=2);assert.equal(st.thought,expected);assert.equal(gain(s).amount,expected);s.moveDefinitions[key(29425)].operations=[];turn(s,29425,10716);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(gain(s).amount,Math.floor(state(s).damageChanges.filter(e=>e.round===2).reduce((n,e)=>n+e.amount,0)+1e-9));assert.equal(state(s).thought,gain(s).amount);});

failure.name: 4933已答正气意念保留期间仍每轮平均魂印回复当前两信仰者，禁技能疗不阻而回复倍率独立，结束后正常消耗
failure.assertion: test('4933已答正气意念保留期间仍每轮平均魂印回复当前两信仰者，禁技能疗不阻而回复倍率独立，结束后正常消耗',()=>{const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1000,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};state(s).thought=600;timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减',{},1,2);timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+r*150);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1000+r*300);assert.equal(state(s).thought,r<3?600:0);assert.equal(gain(s).amount,0);}});

failure.name: 4933已答邪气意念保留仍刷新下次附伤为本轮量，旧附伤不相加，属性和药剂保留，攻击含免固只消费一次
failure.assertion: test('4933已答邪气意念保留仍刷新下次附伤为本轮量，旧附伤不相加，属性和药剂保留，攻击含免固只消费一次',()=>{for(const immune of [false,true]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});state(s).thought=100;state(s).extra=250;timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减',{},1,2);turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(state(s).thought,100);assert.equal(state(s).extra,100);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(state(s).thought,100);assert.equal(state(s).extra,100);if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');s.moveDefinitions[key(38494)].operations=[];turn(s,38494,20117);assert.equal(state(s).extra,0);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:100);assert.equal(state(s).thought,gain(s).amount);}});

failure.name: 4933已答无魂印真实红伤对照校准增减计算基数，残血过量不裁剪层差，多段保留小数到回末统一取整
failure.assertion: test('4933已答无魂印真实红伤对照校准增减计算基数，残血过量不裁剪层差，多段保留小数到回末统一取整',()=>{for(const incoming of [false,true]){const o={move:incoming?29425:38494,index:-1,hp:incoming?9000:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},bStats:{atk:incoming?3000:180}},a=make({...o,soul:true}),b=make(o);turn(a,o.move,incoming?10127:20117);turn(b,o.move,incoming?10127:20117);const e=state(a).damageChanges[0],coef=incoming?.6:.75;assert.equal(Math.floor(e.unit),sum(b,'attack',incoming?1:0));assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',incoming?1:0),Math.floor(e.unit*(incoming?.4:1.75)));assert.equal(state(a).thought,Math.floor(e.unit*coef+1e-9));if(!incoming){const z=make({...o,soul:true,targetHp:1});turn(z,o.move,20117);assert.equal(z.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(state(z).thought,state(a).thought);assert.equal(sum(z),sum(a));}}let witnessed=false;for(let seed=1;seed<=12;seed++){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0,enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});turn(s,38494,10713);const rows=state(s).damageChanges,raw=rows.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.amount,0),separate=rows.reduce((n,e)=>n+Math.floor(e.amount),0);assert.equal(state(s).thought,Math.floor(raw+1e-9));if(state(s).thought>separate)witnessed=true;}assert.equal(witnessed,true);});

boundary.name: 4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方
boundary.assertion: test('4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方',()=>{for(const [atk,spa,form]of[[200,100,'positive'],[100,200,'evil'],[100,100,null]]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk,spa}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.form,form);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].statusState?.faithSourceSide,form?0:undefined);s.fighters[0].ailments['狂信']=5;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29425)],4);}});

boundary.name: 4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗
boundary.assertion: test('4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','skillBan','cut','full']){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='cut')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?9000:mode==='cut'?1150:1300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

boundary.name: 4933邪气消耗意念为下一次攻击固定附伤，属性与药剂不消费，免固仍消费一次
boundary.assertion: test('4933邪气消耗意念为下一次攻击固定附伤，属性与药剂不消费，免固仍消费一次',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,300);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,300);s.moveDefinitions[key(38494)].operations=[];if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,38494,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thoughtGains.at(-1).amount);}});

boundary.name: 4933单个信仰HP分档真实增减伤，魂印层正差在回末实际计意念且免疫不抹去
boundary.assertion: test('4933单个信仰HP分档真实增减伤，魂印层正差在回末实际计意念且免疫不抹去',()=>{const reduced=[];for(const hp of[9000,4499]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});turn(s,29425,10127);reduced.push(sum(s,'attack',1));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,hp-reduced.at(-1));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought>0);}assert.ok(reduced[0]<reduced[1]);const damages=[];for(const hp of[9000,4499]){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});turn(s,38494,20309);damages.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,hp===9000?0:s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thoughtGains.at(-1).amount);}assert.ok(damages[1]>damages[0]);});

boundary.name: 4933双方信仰合计分母为两者最大HP，意念不减仍产附伤且保留，未消费旧附伤刷新本轮值
boundary.assertion: test('4933双方信仰合计分母为两者最大HP，意念不减仍产附伤且保留，未消费旧附伤刷新本轮值',()=>{for(const mode of['two','freeze','extra']){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}}),st=s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128;if(mode==='two')s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};else st.thought=100;if(mode==='freeze')timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减');if(mode==='extra')st.extra=200;turn(s,38494,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38494)],4);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='two'?0:100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,mode==='freeze'?100:0);}});

boundary.name: 4933已答邪气意念保留仍刷新下次附伤为本轮量，旧附伤不相加，属性和药剂保留，攻击含免固只消费一次
boundary.assertion: test('4933已答邪气意念保留仍刷新下次附伤为本轮量，旧附伤不相加，属性和药剂保留，攻击含免固只消费一次',()=>{for(const immune of [false,true]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});state(s).thought=100;state(s).extra=250;timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减',{},1,2);turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(state(s).thought,100);assert.equal(state(s).extra,100);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(state(s).thought,100);assert.equal(state(s).extra,100);if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');s.moveDefinitions[key(38494)].operations=[];turn(s,38494,20117);assert.equal(state(s).extra,0);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:100);assert.equal(state(s).thought,gain(s).amount);}});

boundary.name: 4933已答无魂印真实红伤对照校准增减计算基数，残血过量不裁剪层差，多段保留小数到回末统一取整
boundary.assertion: test('4933已答无魂印真实红伤对照校准增减计算基数，残血过量不裁剪层差，多段保留小数到回末统一取整',()=>{for(const incoming of [false,true]){const o={move:incoming?29425:38494,index:-1,hp:incoming?9000:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},bStats:{atk:incoming?3000:180}},a=make({...o,soul:true}),b=make(o);turn(a,o.move,incoming?10127:20117);turn(b,o.move,incoming?10127:20117);const e=state(a).damageChanges[0],coef=incoming?.6:.75;assert.equal(Math.floor(e.unit),sum(b,'attack',incoming?1:0));assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',incoming?1:0),Math.floor(e.unit*(incoming?.4:1.75)));assert.equal(state(a).thought,Math.floor(e.unit*coef+1e-9));if(!incoming){const z=make({...o,soul:true,targetHp:1});turn(z,o.move,20117);assert.equal(z.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(state(z).thought,state(a).thought);assert.equal(sum(z),sum(a));}}let witnessed=false;for(let seed=1;seed<=12;seed++){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0,enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});turn(s,38494,10713);const rows=state(s).damageChanges,raw=rows.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.amount,0),separate=rows.reduce((n,e)=>n+Math.floor(e.amount),0);assert.equal(state(s).thought,Math.floor(raw+1e-9));if(state(s).thought>separate)witnessed=true;}assert.equal(witnessed,true);});

interaction.name: 4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方
interaction.assertion: test('4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方',()=>{for(const [atk,spa,form]of[[200,100,'positive'],[100,200,'evil'],[100,100,null]]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk,spa}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.form,form);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].statusState?.faithSourceSide,form?0:undefined);s.fighters[0].ailments['狂信']=5;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29425)],4);}});

interaction.name: 4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗
interaction.assertion: test('4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','skillBan','cut','full']){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='cut')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?9000:mode==='cut'?1150:1300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

interaction.name: 4933邪气消耗意念为下一次攻击固定附伤，属性与药剂不消费，免固仍消费一次
interaction.assertion: test('4933邪气消耗意念为下一次攻击固定附伤，属性与药剂不消费，免固仍消费一次',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,300);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,300);s.moveDefinitions[key(38494)].operations=[];if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,38494,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thoughtGains.at(-1).amount);}});

interaction.name: 4933单个信仰HP分档真实增减伤，魂印层正差在回末实际计意念且免疫不抹去
interaction.assertion: test('4933单个信仰HP分档真实增减伤，魂印层正差在回末实际计意念且免疫不抹去',()=>{const reduced=[];for(const hp of[9000,4499]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});turn(s,29425,10127);reduced.push(sum(s,'attack',1));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,hp-reduced.at(-1));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought>0);}assert.ok(reduced[0]<reduced[1]);const damages=[];for(const hp of[9000,4499]){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});turn(s,38494,20309);damages.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,hp===9000?0:s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thoughtGains.at(-1).amount);}assert.ok(damages[1]>damages[0]);});

interaction.name: 4933双方信仰合计分母为两者最大HP，意念不减仍产附伤且保留，未消费旧附伤刷新本轮值
interaction.assertion: test('4933双方信仰合计分母为两者最大HP，意念不减仍产附伤且保留，未消费旧附伤刷新本轮值',()=>{for(const mode of['two','freeze','extra']){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}}),st=s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128;if(mode==='two')s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};else st.thought=100;if(mode==='freeze')timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减');if(mode==='extra')st.extra=200;turn(s,38494,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38494)],4);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='two'?0:100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,mode==='freeze'?100:0);}});

interaction.name: 4933已答信仰比例为双方HP合计除最大HP合计，正邪与总损失比例分档，实际狂信可令当前敌方信仰自身
interaction.assertion: test('4933已答信仰比例为双方HP合计除最大HP合计，正邪与总损失比例分档，实际狂信可令当前敌方信仰自身',()=>{for(const kind of ['incoming','outgoing']){const s=make({move:kind==='incoming'?29425:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,targetHp:3000,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},bStats:{maxHp:3000}});s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};let ratio,modifier;observe((e,c)=>{if(c.a.side!==0)return;if(e===(kind==='incoming'?'beforeIncomingAttack':'beforeDamage')){ratio=E.SOULS.registry[2128].abilities.ratio(c);modifier=kind==='incoming'?c.reduction:c.shuraOutgoing2128?.bonus;}},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,kind==='incoming'?10127:20117));assert.equal(ratio,.625);assert.ok(Math.abs(modifier-(kind==='incoming'?.4:.45))<1e-12);assert.ok(state(s).thought>0);}const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'狂信',c.a,false,false,2),true);},()=>turn(s,29425,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].statusState.faithSourceSide,0);});

interaction.name: 4933已答魂印减伤层差额计意念，后续免疫、护盾和伤害上限不抹去，穿减先削减实际生效比例
interaction.assertion: test('4933已答魂印减伤层差额计意念，后续免疫、护盾和伤害上限不抹去，穿减先削减实际生效比例',()=>{const gains=[];for(const mode of ['normal','immune','shield','cap','pierce']){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},bStats:{atk:3000}});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(s.fighters[0],9000,'4933-layer');if(mode==='cap')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害上限',{amount:1});if(mode==='pierce')markFire(s,1);turn(s,29425,10127);const events=state(s).damageChanges.filter(x=>x.round===1);assert.equal(events.length,1);assert.equal(events[0].kind,'reduction');assert.ok(Math.abs(events[0].coefficient-(mode==='pierce'?.3:.6))<1e-12);assert.equal(state(s).thought,Math.floor(events[0].unit*(mode==='pierce'?.3:.6)+1e-9));assert.ok(state(s).thought>0);gains.push(state(s).thought);if(mode==='immune'||mode==='shield')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);if(mode==='cap')assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),1);}assert.equal(gains[0],gains[1]);assert.equal(gains[0],gains[2]);assert.equal(gains[0],gains[3]);assert.ok(Math.abs(gains[0]-gains[4]*2)<=1);});

interaction.name: 4933已答魂印增伤层差额计意念，后续免攻与整盾不改所得；MISS、整招无效、属性招不凭空产生
interaction.assertion: test('4933已答魂印增伤层差额计意念，后续免攻与整盾不改所得；MISS、整招无效、属性招不凭空产生',()=>{const gains=[];for(const mode of ['normal','immune','shield','miss','invalid','status']){const s=make({move:mode==='status'?29425:mode==='miss'?38492:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss',hp:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(s.fighters[1],9000,'4933-out');if(mode==='miss')timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'attackBlock');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);const amount=state(s).thought;gains.push(amount);if(['miss','invalid','status'].includes(mode)){assert.equal(amount,0);assert.equal(state(s).damageChanges?.length??0,0);}else{const e=state(s).damageChanges[0];assert.equal(e.kind,'increase');assert.equal(e.coefficient,.75);assert.equal(amount,Math.floor(e.unit*.75+1e-9));assert.ok(amount>0);if(mode!=='normal')assert.equal(sum(s),0);}}assert.equal(gains[0],gains[1]);assert.equal(gains[0],gains[2]);});

interaction.name: 4933已答多段与双方同回合增减差额合计后一次取整，非红伤不计，下回合从本回零重新累计
interaction.assertion: test('4933已答多段与双方同回合增减差额合计后一次取整，非红伤不计，下回合从本回零重新累计',()=>{const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});turn(s,38494,10713);const st=state(s),events=st.damageChanges.filter(x=>x.round===1),expected=Math.floor(events.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.amount,0)+1e-9);assert.ok(events.some(e=>e.kind==='increase'));assert.ok(events.filter(e=>e.kind==='reduction').length>=2);assert.equal(st.thought,expected);assert.equal(gain(s).amount,expected);s.moveDefinitions[key(29425)].operations=[];turn(s,29425,10716);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(gain(s).amount,Math.floor(state(s).damageChanges.filter(e=>e.round===2).reduce((n,e)=>n+e.amount,0)+1e-9));assert.equal(state(s).thought,gain(s).amount);});

interaction.name: 4933已答正气意念保留期间仍每轮平均魂印回复当前两信仰者，禁技能疗不阻而回复倍率独立，结束后正常消耗
interaction.assertion: test('4933已答正气意念保留期间仍每轮平均魂印回复当前两信仰者，禁技能疗不阻而回复倍率独立，结束后正常消耗',()=>{const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1000,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};state(s).thought=600;timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减',{},1,2);timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+r*150);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1000+r*300);assert.equal(state(s).thought,r<3?600:0);assert.equal(gain(s).amount,0);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4933已答邪气意念保留仍刷新下次附伤为本轮量，旧附伤不相加，属性和药剂保留，攻击含免固只消费一次',()=>{for(const immune of [false,true]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});state(s).thought=100;state(s).extra=250;timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减',{},1,2);turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(state(s).thought,100);assert.equal(state(s).extra,100);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(state(s).thought,100);assert.equal(state(s).extra,100);if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');s.moveDefinitions[key(38494)].operations=[];turn(s,38494,20117);assert.equal(state(s).extra,0);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:100);assert.equal(state(s).thought,gain(s).amount);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4933已答无魂印真实红伤对照校准增减计算基数，残血过量不裁剪层差，多段保留小数到回末统一取整',()=>{for(const incoming of [false,true]){const o={move:incoming?29425:38494,index:-1,hp:incoming?9000:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},bStats:{atk:incoming?3000:180}},a=make({...o,soul:true}),b=make(o);turn(a,o.move,incoming?10127:20117);turn(b,o.move,incoming?10127:20117);const e=state(a).damageChanges[0],coef=incoming?.6:.75;assert.equal(Math.floor(e.unit),sum(b,'attack',incoming?1:0));assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',incoming?1:0),Math.floor(e.unit*(incoming?.4:1.75)));assert.equal(state(a).thought,Math.floor(e.unit*coef+1e-9));if(!incoming){const z=make({...o,soul:true,targetHp:1});turn(z,o.move,20117);assert.equal(z.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(state(z).thought,state(a).thought);assert.equal(sum(z),sum(a));}}let witnessed=false;for(let seed=1;seed<=12;seed++){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0,enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});turn(s,38494,10713);const rows=state(s).damageChanges,raw=rows.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.amount,0),separate=rows.reduce((n,e)=>n+Math.floor(e.amount),0);assert.equal(state(s).thought,Math.floor(raw+1e-9));if(state(s).thought>separate)witnessed=true;}assert.equal(witnessed,true);});
